scope: Lossless production recording, absolute-clock replay, loops, pause, path discontinuity and CPU cost. Native M1 and hardware WebGL are separate.

tests.name: Binary64 shuffle roundtrip preserves every source bit
Wall-clock tempo is exactly 1x at 30, 60, 144 Hz and irregular delivery
Pause and reset do not catch up hidden time
Loop timestamps remain monotone and path breaks delimit each wrap
Wrap breaks the beam path while retaining phosphor and simulated time
Bundled recording hashes and all original model files agree
Recorded beam is presented with live CPU optics within a measured budget

cpuFallback.host: Linux/Node, not M1/Firefox or a browser FPS result
